function: Single-stranded DNA-binding protein that interacts with LIM-domain binding protein Chi; as a complex these proteins mediate transcription of developmental control genes via remote enhancers.
subunit: Homodimer; via its N-terminal LisH domain; may form dimer of dimers (PubMed:31570581). Interacts with Chi; as a complex these proteins mediate transcription of developmental control genes (PubMed:31570581).
